_rules: Every line here must stay true of the live product. No 'undetectable', 'stealth', 'invisible', 'guaranteed job/offer' or 'get hired fast'.
No invented numbers, ratings, user counts, testimonials or employer logos. Never name an AI vendor.
Headlines: sentence case, 7 words at most. India copy in Indian English (practise, freshers, placements, HR round, switch).
Prices never live here: {price} is filled in at export (README), and a creative without a price shows none.
